)

)

    :precondition (holding ?b)

      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
    )

      (not (arm-empty))
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)

  )
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: history predicate for the additional hold-block4 requirement.
    (was-holding ?x)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      (holding ?b)
      ;; CONSTRAINT: mark the block as held.
      (was-holding ?b)
    )
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and
      (not (holding ?b))
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (on-table ?b)
    )
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?c))
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (on ?b ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and
      (not (on ?b ?c))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (clear ?c)
      (holding ?b)
      (not (arm-empty))
      ;; CONSTRAINT: mark the block as held.
      (was-holding ?b)
    )
  )
)

    (on ?x ?y)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  ;; CONSTRAINT-ADD: height levels used to enforce the 5-block stack limit.
  (:constants h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; CONSTRAINT-ADD: height tracks the tower height above the table for each block.
    (height ?b ?h)
    ;; CONSTRAINT-ADD: next defines legal +1 steps; no next from h5 keeps stacks <= 5.
    (next ?h1 ?h2)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (height ?b h1))
                 (not (height ?b h2))
                 (not (height ?b h3))
                 (not (height ?b h4))
                 (not (height ?b h5))
                 (not (height ?b h6))
                 (not (height ?b h7))))

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (height ?b h1)))

  ;; CONSTRAINT-ADD: stack is limited by the height of the destination block.
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?h ?h2)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b)
                       (clear ?c)
                       (height ?c ?h)
                       (next ?h ?h2))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 (height ?b ?h2)))

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (height ?b h1))
                 (not (height ?b h2))
                 (not (height ?b h3))
                 (not (height ?b h4))
                 (not (height ?b h5))
                 (not (height ?b h6))
                 (not (height ?b h7))))
)

    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))

    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))

Domain:
(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ; CONSTRAINT: one token predicate per allowed pick-up. Each pickup/unstack consumes one token.
    (pickup-available ?p)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b ?p)
    :precondition (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (pickup-available ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      (not (pickup-available ?p))
    )
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
    )
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
    )
    :effect (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?c))
    )
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?p)
    :precondition (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (pickup-available ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (not (on ?b ?c))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      (not (pickup-available ?p))
    )
  )
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: A block can be moved only when it is clear, i.e. it is at the top of its stack.
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: The target block must be clear before placing a held block on it.
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :negative-preconditions :disjunctive-preconditions :quantified-preconditions :conditional-effects :numeric-fluents)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ; CONSTRAINT: support-chain ?x ?y means y is at-or-below x in x's current stack
    (support-chain ?x ?y)
  )
  (:functions
    ; CONSTRAINT: fixed weight of each block
    (weight ?b)
    ; CONSTRAINT: current total weight of all blocks above ?b
    (total-above ?b)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition
      (and
        (on-table ?b)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        ; CONSTRAINT: all loads within capacities before any move
        (forall (?x) (>= (weight ?x) (total-above ?x)))
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (not (on-table ?b))
        (not (clear ?b))
        (not (arm-empty))
        (assign (total-above ?b) 0)
        ; holding block no longer has any support chain
        (forall (?x) (when (support-chain ?b ?x) (not (support-chain ?b ?x))))
      )
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (forall (?x) (>= (weight ?x) (total-above ?x)))
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (on-table ?b)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (not (holding ?b))
        (assign (total-above ?b) 0)
        (support-chain ?b ?b)
      )
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (clear ?c)
        (forall (?x) (>= (weight ?x) (total-above ?x)))
        ; CONSTRAINT: placing ?b on ?c adds its weight to ?c and every supporting block
        (forall (?x)
          (or (not (support-chain ?c ?x))
              (>= (weight ?x) (+ (total-above ?x) (weight ?b)))))
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (on ?b ?c)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (not (holding ?b))
        (not (clear ?c))
        (support-chain ?b ?b)
        (forall (?x) (when (support-chain ?c ?x) (support-chain ?b ?x)))
        (forall (?x) (when (support-chain ?c ?x) (increase (total-above ?x) (weight ?b))))
      )
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition
      (and
        (on ?b ?c)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (forall (?x) (>= (weight ?x) (total-above ?x)))
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (clear ?c)
        (not (on ?b ?c))
        (not (clear ?b))
        (not (arm-empty))
        (assign (total-above ?b) 0)
        (forall (?x) (when (support-chain ?b ?x) (not (support-chain ?b ?x))))
        (forall (?x) (when (support-chain ?c ?x) (decrease (total-above ?x) (weight ?b))))

  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates (on ?x ?y) (on-table ?x) (clear ?x) (holding ?x) (arm-empty))

  ; Standard Blocksworld actions
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (clear ?b)) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)) (clear ?b) (on ?b ?c) (arm-empty)))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
)

      (on h i)
      (clear h)

      (on-table b) (clear b)

      (on-table d) (clear d)
      (on-table e) (clear e)

```
(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ; CONSTRAINT: `unlocked` marks blocks that are not permanently fixed by a
    ; stack action performed during the plan. Initial stacks are not locked.
    (unlocked ?x)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    ; CONSTRAINT: once ?b is stacked by this action, it can never be unstacked.
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                 (not (unlocked ?b))
                 (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    ; CONSTRAINT: only an unlocked block may be unstacked.
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (unlocked ?b))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)
```

    (no-obligation)
    (remaining ?s)
    (next ?s ?t)
    (ordinary ?b)
    (is-block1 ?b)
    (is-block2 ?b)
  )

  ;; Ordinary pickup while no pending block2 obligation
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (ordinary ?b) (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (no-obligation))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))

  ;; Ordinary pickup while countdown is active (decrements the deadline)
  (:action pickup-countdown
    :parameters (?b ?s ?t)
    :precondition (and (ordinary ?b) (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                       (remaining ?s) (next ?s ?t))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (remaining ?s)) (remaining ?t)))

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (no-obligation))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))

  (:action putdown-countdown
    :parameters (?b ?s ?t)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (remaining ?s) (next ?s ?t))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (remaining ?s)) (remaining ?t)))

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (no-obligation))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))))

  (:action stack-countdown
    :parameters (?b ?c ?s ?t)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (remaining ?s) (next ?s ?t))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))
                 (not (remaining ?s)) (remaining ?t)))

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (ordinary ?b) (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (no-obligation))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :disjunctive-preconditions :conditional-effects)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ; CONSTRAINT: move parity
    (odd-move)
    (even-move)
    ; CONSTRAINT: block number is a multiple of 4
    (multiple-of-4 ?b)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition
    (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      ; CONSTRAINT: even-numbered moves must move a multiple-of-4 block
      (or (odd-move)
          (and (even-move) (multiple-of-4 ?b)))
    )
    :effect
    (and
      ; toggle parity
      (when (odd-move) (and (not (odd-move)) (even-move)))
      (when (even-move) (and (not (even-move)) (odd-move)))
      (holding ?b)
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
    )
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition
    (and
      (holding ?b)
      (or (odd-move)
          (and (even-move) (multiple-of-4 ?b)))
    )
    :effect
    (and
      (when (odd-move) (and (not (odd-move)) (even-move)))
      (when (even-move) (and (not (even-move)) (odd-move)))
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
    )
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition
    (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (or (odd-move)
          (and (even-move) (multiple-of-4 ?b)))
    )
    :effect
    (and
      (when (odd-move) (and (not (odd-move)) (even-move)))
      (when (even-move) (and (not (even-move)) (odd-move)))
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?c))
    )
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition
    (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (or (odd-move)
          (and (even-move) (multiple-of-4 ?b)))
    )
    :effect
    (and
      (when (odd-move) (and (not (odd-move)) (even-move)))
      (when (even-move) (and (not (even-move)) (odd-move)))
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (not (on ?b ?c))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
    )
  )
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: The arm can move only one block at a time.
  ;; Pickup: a block may be picked from the table only if it is clear and the arm is empty.
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (holding ?b))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: A held block may be placed on the table, making the arm empty and the block clear.
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (not (holding ?b)) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (on-table ?b))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: A held block may be stacked on another block only if the target block is clear.
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (on ?b ?c))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: A clear block on top of another block may be unstacked only if the arm is empty.
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
  )

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :negative-preconditions)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)

    (never-putdown ?x)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (never-putdown ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (not (never-putdown ?b)))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)          ; x is on y
    (on-table ?x)       ; x is on the table
    (clear ?x)          ; x has nothing on it
    (holding ?x)        ; the arm is holding x
    (arm-empty)         ; the arm is not holding anything

  ; CONSTRAINT: The arm can move/hold only one block at a time.
  ; This is represented by the arm-empty/holding preconditions and effects.

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))))

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))))

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))))

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty)))))

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: Only one block can be moved at a time.
  ;; The arm-empty predicate enforces that the arm cannot grasp a
  ;; second block while already holding one.
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: A block can be stacked only onto a clear block
  ;; and only if the arm is currently holding exactly one block.
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: A block can be unstacked only when it is clear
  ;; and the arm is empty.
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :negative-preconditions)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: marks forbidden support relations
    (forbidden ?x ?y)
  )
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    ; CONSTRAINT: do not allow stacking b on c if that relation is forbidden
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (forbidden ?b ?c)))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: pickup requires an empty arm and a clear block on the table.
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (holding ?b))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: putdown places a held block on the table.
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: stack places a held block only on a clear block.
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (on ?b ?c))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: unstack removes a clear block from atop another block.
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)

  (:requirements :strips)

  ; CONSTRAINT: A block can only be moved when it is clear, and the arm can
  ; hold at most one block at a time.

  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: pickup is allowed only from the table, with an empty arm,
  ; and the block must be clear.
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
    )
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: putdown places a held block onto the table.
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
    )
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: stack places a held block onto a clear block; the target is
  ; no longer clear, and the held block is now clear.
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?c))
    )
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: unstack removes a clear block from atop a block, clearing the
  ; block below and putting the removed block into the hand.
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (not (on ?b ?c))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
    )
  )
)
```

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)

  ; CONSTRAINT: A block can only be moved when it is clear, and the arm can hold at most one block at a time.

  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: pickup is allowed only from the table, with an empty arm, and the block must be clear.
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
    )
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: putdown places a held block onto the table.
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
    )
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: stack places a held block onto a clear block; the target is no longer clear, and the held block is now clear.
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?c))
    )
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: unstack removes a clear block from atop a block, clears the block below, and puts the removed block into the hand.
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (not (on ?b ?c))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
    )
  )
)

                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: A held block may be placed on the table. The table is always clear in this model.
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b)))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: Stacking requires the held block to be placed on a clear destination block.
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c)))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: Unstacking removes a clear block from atop another block into the hand.
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty)))
  )

      (when (and (not (is-block2 ?b)) (slot2-two))

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )

  ; CONSTRAINT: The arm can hold at most one block.

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
    )
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (on-table ?b)
      (not (holding ?b))
    )
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (on ?b ?c)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?c))
    )
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (not (on ?b ?c))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
    )
  )
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: marks block and support used in final completion action
    (final-block ?x)
    (final-support ?x)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: completion marker; cleared by every non-final action
    (completed)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 ;; CONSTRAINT: any non-final action clears the completion marker
                 (not (completed))))

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (completed))))

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 (not (completed))))

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (completed))))

  ;; CONSTRAINT: final completion action; equivalent to stacking the marked block
  ;; on the marked support while holding that block, and leaves the completion
  ;; marker true.
  (:action finish
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (final-block ?b) (final-support ?c))
    :effect (and (completed)
                 (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))))
)
```
